node.title: Re^4: Howto convert Image::Grab jpg object to Image::Magick object???
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
For this example code, I'm not sure if you need the conversion to [mod://GD], since [mod://Image::Magick] supports a ->Draw command. Here's another untested copy-n-paste from [http://www.imagemagick.org/script/perl-magick.php|the docs] you could try:

$image->Draw(stroke=>'red', primitive=>'rectangle', points=>20,20 100,100');

Where $image is an Image::Magick object.
